## Local SHA-256 freeze requirement

Before execution authorization, the local executor shall compute SHA-256 over the exact UTF-8 bytes of every bundle component and persist the resulting values in a second manifest. Executor-2 shall independently recompute those SHA-256 values. Any mismatch is a hard block.

The Git blob identifiers above are not substituted for SHA-256; they provide repository-level provenance and immutable content identity.
